mapper.insert: insert into feed_logs (house_id, item_id, feeding_rabbits, feed_time, feed_type, unit, request_id, amount, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{itemId}, #{feedingRabbits}, #{feedTime}, #{feedType}, #{unit}, #{requestId}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select * from feed_logs where house_id = #{houseId} order by feed_time desc, id desc

select * from ( (select fl.* from feed_logs fl inner join feed_log_rabbits flr on flr.feed_log_id = fl.id where fl.house_id = #{houseId} and flr.cage_id = #{cageId} order by fl.feed_time desc, fl.id desc limit 1) union all (select fl.* from feed_logs fl where fl.house_id = #{houseId} and not exists (select 1 from feed_log_rabbits flr2 where flr2.feed_log_id = fl.id) and exists ( select 1 from rabbits r where r.house_id = fl.house_id and r.cage_id = #{cageId} and find_in_set(cast(r.id as char), fl.feeding_rabbits) > 0 ) order by fl.feed_time desc, fl.id desc limit 1) ) t order by t.feed_time desc, t.id desc limit 1

select id, house_id, item_id, feeding_rabbits, feed_time, feed_type, unit, request_id, amount, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from feed_logs fl where fl.house_id = #{houseId} and fl.feeding_rabbits is not null and fl.feeding_rabbits <> '' and not exists (select 1 from feed_log_rabbits flr where flr.feed_log_id = fl.id) order by fl.id asc limit #{limit}
